commit.subject: LU-10026 lov: disable compression for DoM
commit.message:
LU-10026 lov: disable compression for DoM

Disallow enabling compression on the DoM component until
the related feature is properly fixed.

Added a test to ensure this combination is prohibited,
while confirming that DoM continues to function normally.

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
DDN-bug-id: EX-8718
Signed-off-by: Artem Blagodarenko <ablagodarenko@ddn.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Vef <mvef@whamcloud.com>
